novelty_basis: Not stated in B. Le Floch's ETP notes (which list 467, 1313, 1516 as 'starting with' sizes up to 8 or 7, 1286 as 'starting with 1, 7', and give no sizes for 677); the ETP paper (arXiv:2512.07087, v2) separates full from non-full spectra and defers detailed spectra to a forthcoming publication. Our reading of that paper was partial (the spectrum section was truncated in retrieval), and ETP model searches may already contain these models; novelty is therefore only relative to the sources read (2026-10-18).

title: New spectrum memberships for open ETP laws: 467, 1286, 1313, 1516 have models of order 9; 677 has models of orders 5, 7, 9
